decision: No available independent dataset can reconstruct the exact Kudla native start window UTR[-4:]+CDS[:38] for a fixed-protein synonymous transport test with fresh continuous outcome. Record missing dimensions and formally trigger the branch-2 pivot to data-supported functional sequence models / translation dynamics; stop treating start-aware MFE as the core model innovation.
missing_dimensions: Fixed-protein synonymous library (Boel is cross-protein non-synonymous).
Native variant-specific 5'UTR (>=4 nt upstream of ATG) captured per construct (no UTR column in any available source; Mordstein truncated; MAGE no full construct).
Full CDS with start ATG in an independent cross-host study (Mordstein observed-R1 starts at CDS position 4).
Fresh continuous expression/fitness outcome with adequate dynamic range (Boel is ordinal 0-5).
Protein family map for protein/study OOD isolation (Boel family map absent).
Documented license/accession/raw SHA for a qualifying construct-level dataset.
non_claims: Feasibility/eligibility audit only; no transport effect, no SOTA, no mechanism claim; functional untouched not read for outcomes; no generative training.

pivot_plan.candidate_next_task_RK37: Preregistered translation-speed / functional prediction benchmark on available bounded clean data (e.g., RiboMIMO), with strong constant/ridge controls, CAI/GC and full-proxy MFE baselines, general sequence models, protein/study OOD Spearman/RMSE/top-k enrichment; SOTA requires paired 95% CI lower>0, multiplicity pass, 100% legality, full cost.
pivot_plan.data_to_seek: Public construct-level synonymous datasets with native full UTR-CDS and continuous fresh outcome in an independent host/study (e.g., cross-host synonymous fitness with full construct sequences, or measured-structure synonymous data); Cambray 2018 fixed-UTR constructs require raw construct verification before any transport claim.
pivot_plan.direction: Data-supported functional sequence modeling / translation dynamics, not start-aware MFE as core innovation.
pivot_plan.trigger: branch_2 (no qualifying independent transport data; RK23 Boel protein-OOD 0/4 and RK25 mechanism 0/2 already constitute cross-protein/cross-host transport failure).
